name: respondToAppointmentRequest
shortDescription: Allows a doctor to approve or decline a pending appointment request from a patient.
description:
Overview

Enables doctors to review and respond to pending appointment requests from patients, either approving or declining them, and notifying the patient.

Intended use

Called by the doctor-facing UI when a doctor processes an appointment request. It requires appointmentId and an action (e.g., 'approve', 'decline').

Logic

  1. Retrieve the Appointment record using params.appointmentId.
  2. Verify that the authenticated user is the doctor associated with the appointment.
  3. Based on params.action ('approve' or 'decline'):
    • If 'approve': Update Appointment.status to 'confirmed' using ctx.data.update.
    • If 'decline': Update Appointment.status to 'declined' and optionally add notes using ctx.data.update.
  4. Send a notification email to the patient about the decision using ctx.email.send_template.
  5. Audit-log the doctor's response to the appointment request using ctx.audit.log.
  6. Return the updated Appointment record.

Entities

  • Appointment
  • Patient
  • Doctor
